name: CockpitState

test_list.description: A fresh CLI opens on the conversation with no panel open or pinned.
Panel toggle and focus cycle preserve the main composer submission target.
Viewport changes represent a sheet, indicator or resize notice without taking main focus.
A focused narrow panel becomes a sheet; too-small layouts request a resize.
Selecting or focusing a child panel never changes the submission target.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Pure transient panel, focus, pin and geometry state.

inputs.name: viewport
inputs.description: Viewport width/height class from shared layout.

output_description: Pure transient panel selection, viewport, pin and focus state; no backend calls or execution ownership.
